谢谢你认真完成。

首次点准 166/168 次。

重复顺序与对照顺序中，下面记录的是首次就点准时的软件反应时间；首答点错后纠正的时间没有混入。

重复顺序 500 ms；对照 1,000 ms；差值（对照减重复）+500 ms。

这次重复顺序下稍快。

可以回想什么时候更容易看清、点准；活动后让手休息一下。

触屏动作距离、姿势、熟悉程度、注意和疲劳都会影响结果。短版重复更少，长短版等值性未验证；这不是隐性学习能力证明，也不是智力、常模、诊断、同龄排名、学业或岗位预测。
text.en:
This session of serial tapping

Thank you for completing the activity.

First tap correct: 166/168.

These software response times include only trials on which the first tap was correct. Time spent correcting an incorrect first tap is excluded.

Repeated order: 500 ms. Control: 1,000 ms. Control minus repeated: +500 ms.

Repeated-order responses were faster in this session.

Think about what helped you see and tap accurately, then give your hand a rest.

Touch movement, posture, familiarity, attention and fatigue affect performance. The short profile has fewer repetitions and equivalence is unvalidated. This does not establish implicit-learning ability, intelligence, norms, diagnosis, age ranking, school or job predictions.

text.zh:
谢谢你已经付出的努力。这次未完整完成、发生中断或有较多首答点错，先不解释表现差别。可以休息后重新看说明，再决定是否完整体验；本次没有表现评分。

触屏动作距离、姿势、熟悉程度、注意和疲劳都会影响结果。短版重复更少，长短版等值性未验证；这不是隐性学习能力证明，也不是智力、常模、诊断、同龄排名、学业或岗位预测。
text.en:
Thank you for your effort. This session was incomplete, interrupted or contained many incorrect first taps, so we will not interpret performance differences. Rest and review the instructions before deciding whether to try a complete activity. No performance score is shown.

Touch movement, posture, familiarity, attention and fatigue affect performance. The short profile has fewer repetitions and equivalence is unvalidated. This does not establish implicit-learning ability, intelligence, norms, diagnosis, age ranking, school or job predictions.

text.zh:
